name: Workiva
description: Workiva is a secure collaborative reporting and governance platform for financial reporting, sustainability, audit, risk, compliance, controls, documents, spreadsheets, presentations, tasks, records, and regulatory filings.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-created, expiring Workiva workspace API grant for a dedicated integration user in the exact US, EU, or APAC region with only file:read scope. Selected agents can list one first page of at most 20 minimized file and folder metadata records; Relay blocks contents, permissions, people, exports, cross-workspace access, broad APIs, and every mutation.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer has supplied a non-production Workiva workspace with a dedicated integration user, an expiring workspace API grant restricted to only file:read, and representative file-directory data for regional and minimization acceptance. Workiva API grants inherit the selected user's permissions, so the integration user and its accessible files must also be intentionally minimized.
providerSetup.nextAction: A Workiva Workspace Owner or Org Security Admin creates a dedicated least-privilege integration user in a non-production workspace, limits that user to the intended files, creates an expiring API grant with only file:read and the correct US, EU, or APAC region, stores the client ID and one-time-visible secret through Relay's encrypted credential flow, and validates exact-scope token issuance, the bounded file metadata read, denied contents, exports, permissions, people, cross-workspace and write access, rate handling, secret regeneration, grant deletion, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Workiva's current versioned REST API overview documents OAuth credential exchange and the supported files, folders, documents, spreadsheets, presentations, tasks, users, organizations, workspaces, records, and reports surfaces.
Workiva documents OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials, form or JSON token exchange, Bearer authentication, the mandatory 2026-01-01 version header, and approximately ten-minute access tokens.

Workiva documents administrator-created workspace API grants bound to one workspace and user, selectable scopes, expiration and optional IP allowlists, one-time-visible regeneratable secrets, editing, and deletion.

Workiva states that Client Credentials is mandatory, grants inherit the selected user's permissions, each grant is attributed to one workspace, a dedicated integration user is preferred, and only minimum scopes should be selected.

The current GET /files contract requires only file:read, accepts a bounded maximum page size and opaque pagination cursor, and returns file identifiers, names, kinds, types, state, template status, containers, and milestone metadata. Relay returns only a minimized subset and does not follow the next link.
Workiva documents exact US, EU, and APAC IAM and Platform API origins and requires appropriate permissions for the dedicated integration user rather than arbitrary host overrides.

Workiva documents 429 rate limiting with Retry-After, a 10 MB request maximum, and a 29-second request timeout. Relay makes one bounded request, does not retry automatically, and uses a shorter timeout.
